text: I think the main reasons are higher salaries and better career opportunities. In some countries, specialists such as doctors or engineers earn much more than at home. Also, working abroad is a good chance to improve your language and learn a new way of working. Of course, it can be hard to be away from family, but many people think it is worth it. Personally, I would try it for a few years.

tips.en: Set opening phrases (In my opinion, I'd say) sound natural in spoken answers.
tips.kk: Тұрақты кіріспе тіркестер (In my opinion, I'd say) ауызша сөйлеуде табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Устойчивые вводные формулы (In my opinion, I'd say) звучат естественно в устной речи.
tips.example: I think the main reasons are higher salaries

tips.en: Concession phrases show flexible thinking and strengthen the argument.
tips.kk: Келісу тіркестері ойдың икемділігін көрсетеді және дәлелді күшейтеді.
tips.ru: Выражения уступки показывают гибкость мышления и усиливают аргумент.
tips.example: Of course, it can be hard to be away from family

questions.question: Why do some people want to work abroad?

text: Each has its advantages. A big company usually offers a stable salary and clear career steps, so it feels safer. But in a small company you often get more responsibility early, and you can see the result of your work. I'd probably choose a small one while I'm young, since I'd learn faster. Later, when I have a family, stability may matter more to me.

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: But in a small company you often get more responsibility early

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
tips.kk: Жұмсартатын сөздер табиғи естіледі, пікірді тым қатаң етпейді.
tips.ru: Смягчающие выражения звучат естественно и не делают утверждение слишком категоричным.
tips.example: I'd probably choose a small one while I'm young

questions.question: Do you think it's better to work for a big company or a small one?

text: I think it's very important, because we spend most of the day at work. If the atmosphere is bad, people get stressed and the quality of their work goes down. On the other hand, you don't have to be best friends with everyone. It's enough to respect each other and communicate politely. In my experience, a friendly team also helps you stay motivated even when the tasks are difficult.

tips.en: Conditional structures (if, otherwise, once) add complexity and precision.
tips.kk: Шартты құрылымдар (if, otherwise, once) жауапты күрделі әрі нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Условные конструкции (if, otherwise, once) добавляют сложность и точность.
tips.example: If the atmosphere is bad, people get stressed

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: On the other hand, you don't have to be best friends with everyone

note.en: the general feeling in a place

questions.question: How important is it for employees to get on well with their colleagues?

text: Not most jobs, I think, but many routine ones. Robots are already used in factories and warehouses, and they will probably do more of the dangerous or repetitive work. However, jobs that need creativity or human contact, like teaching and nursing, will be much harder to replace. So the important thing is for workers to keep learning, because the skills we need are going to change.

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
tips.kk: Жұмсартатын сөздер табиғи естіледі, пікірді тым қатаң етпейді.
tips.ru: Смягчающие выражения звучат естественно и не делают утверждение слишком категоричным.

tips.en: Accurate future forms (will, may, could) show grammatical range when predicting.
tips.kk: Келер шақ формалары (will, may, could) болжам жасағанда грамматикалық ауқымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Верные формы будущего (will, may, could) показывают грамматический диапазон при прогнозах.
